messages:
nina: RFC follow-up idea: split resolver into FastPath + HeavyEvaluator. FastPath must be sync, deterministic. HeavyEvaluator is optional async/refinement.

omar: What does FastPath return? route ids or handles?

nina: Lightweight handles: {route_id, warm_score, static_cost}. Ordered list + tie_seed.

kevin: tie_seed = hash(tenant_id, request_id, cluster_seed) to avoid per-replica randomness.

alice: HeavyEvaluator should have a short in-path budget (default 20ms) and fall back to FastPath ordering if it times out.

nina: Add eval-coalescer keyed by (policy_id, candidates_hash) to dedupe work.

omar: Telemetry: decision.token, fastpath.latency_ms, evaluator.latency_ms, fallback_used. Also reason_code on chosen route.

kevin: Circuit-breaker metrics: policy.evaluator.errors, policy.evaluator.timeouts, policy.decision.fallback_count.

alice: Migration plan: OFF=Migrate nothing, MIXED=FastPath only with old ordering, ON=enable evaluator. Rollout via feature-flag + canary.

policy-bot: :eyes: Canary created: 4% traffic, regions=[us-west-2], duration=24h.

nina: Tests: deterministic tie-breaker, evaluator-timeout, coalescing stress. I'll draft proto + small PR.

kevin: Lgtm. Keep hot path allocation-free and use pooled CandidateHandle objects.

nina: Thanks all, will post RFC tonight.
